what.text: This page follows refugees from Bahrain in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 267 Bahraini refugees, and the United Kingdom hosted 40.4% of them.
After the United Kingdom, the largest hosts are Germany, Canada and France.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Bahrain, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2012 and 2014 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1990 at 39 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 557, at the end of 2019.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
